risks.if_unproven: Cannot be priced at all without this; treat as unpriceable until model is confirmed.

risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic unspecified lens, not the claimed kit+prime combo.

risks.risk: Functional status (shutter, autofocus, sensor dust/scratches, video recording) is unverified.

risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working / non-functional per the worst-case rule.

risks.risk: Shutter count/usage history unknown, affecting mechanical lifespan value.
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or EXIF data reader.

risks.risk: Battery, charger, and memory card inclusion not shown or mentioned.
risks.proof: Photo of full accessory set laid out together.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the model name on the top plate or the camera's power-on LCD screen
Close-up of both lens barrels showing focal length and 'Nikon' markings
A short video of the camera powering on and taking/playing back a photo
Photo looking through the lens mount at the sensor for dust/scratches
Photo of included accessories (battery, charger, memory card, caps)
response.reason: The Nikon logo is visible but no model number can be read anywhere in the photo, and Nikon DSLR prices vary widely by model across the comparables list, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without a legible model shot.
